attribution_limitations: The abstract reports the case 1 device as implanted for approximately 9.5 years together with 695 of 956 (73%) episodes converted, whereas the case text gives the same counts for the first seven years after device placement. The 9.5 years is a stated implant duration, not explicitly the counting window, and the case text reports no IART detected after the CRT upgrade, so this is an unreconciled period rather than two values for one attribute.

Age 22 at initial presentation, an electrophysiology study one year later, then surgery two months later at age 24: the intervals and ages fit only if presentation was late in the 22nd year, and the source does not reconcile them (arithmetic only, not a source conflict). Likewise the device placement roughly 1 year 4 months after the age-24 surgery, the first seven years after device placement and the generator replacement at age 32 are not reconciled to exact ages.

The abstract states the patients with biventricular physiology were able to forgo DC cardioversion after receiving their ATDs; this covers cases 1 and 2 together and is not copied as an individual fact. The case 1 discussion separately states no cardioversions were required.
